sources.name: Broker-Test.at: Nichtmeldefonds, pauschale Besteuerung
sources.says: Dated 23 December 2025. A Meldefonds reports its tax data, through a tax representative in Austria, to the Österreichische Kontrollbank (OeKB); the data can be looked up on my.oekb.at by ISIN. For a Nichtmeldefonds a lump-sum income is set at 31 December: 90% of the year's price gain, at least 10% of the fund's value at 31 December, taxed at 27.5%. Many US ETFs with no OeKB report count as Nichtmeldefonds; it names VOO, QQQ, DGRO and VTI, and US REITs, BDCs and Canadian trusts. The article covers funds and ETFs only; share ISINs are not found on my.oekb.at.

claims.claim: The US estate exemption is $15M in 2026

sources.says: The table "Basic exclusion amount for year of death" has the row 2026: $15,000,000 (2025: $13,990,000). sources.name: IRS: Estate tax
sources.says: A return is required when the gross estate, plus adjusted taxable gifts and specific exemption, is more than the filing threshold for the year of death; the table gives 2026: $15,000,000. Page last reviewed or updated 23-Oct-2026.

sources.says: "Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000", up from $13,990,000 for 2025; the release (October 9, 2025) cites Revenue Procedure 2025-32 and is marked as an archival document.
